## Fork this project

Fork or clone the standalone repository and register the new checkout with the
[pinned build workflow](build.md). Customize the [slide source and theme](authoring.md)
and update the manuscript metadata and root citation files for your fork.
Keep source citations tied to the reference used to generate the deck.
